result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with no stock left. I ran the full test suite with `mvn -q -o test` and it passed with no output. I didn't add a test for the zero-quantity case.

The change is in `StockStore.listInWarehouse` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockStore.java`. The query now has `AND s.quantity > 0`, which is the same filter the other stock overviews use. I also updated the method's Javadoc to say it lists only stock that is left.

`findQuantity` is unchanged, so asking for the quantity of nuts in WH-1 still answers 0.
